root.label: Newsom says reparations legacy involves more than cash payments

events.label: Newsom says reparations legacy involves more than cash payments

slots.name: statement date
slots.sentence: Newsom previously stopped short of endorsing the task force’s proposed direct cash payments. In a 2023 statement to Fox News Digital, the governor said addressing slavery’s legacy extended beyond sending checks to eligible residents.

slots.name: cash payments endorsement status
slots.sentence: "Dealing with that legacy is about much more than cash payments," Newsom said at the time.
